title: KHost Plugin Manifest
description: Metadata for a KHost plugin. Place as manifest.json beside the plugin's entry assembly.

id.description: Unique plugin id: a GUID, generated once when the plugin is created and never changed.

name.description: Display name shown on the Plugins page.

version.description: Plugin version; should match the entry assembly's version.

icon.description: A Bootstrap Icons glyph name, or "image" to use the plugin.icon.png shipped beside this manifest (PNG, at most 128x128). Omit for the generic glyph.

entryAssembly.description: File name of the plugin assembly, relative to this manifest.

apiVersion.description: KHost plugin API version this plugin was built against.

settings.description: Settings the host collects and hands to the plugin via IPlugin (GetSetting/BindSettings).

default.description: Value used when the host has none stored.

buttons.description: Buttons the host draws on the plugin's row and runs through IPluginButtonHandler.

label.description: Wording when the handler does not override it.
